description: This file defines the MarketplaceEntitlementServiceClient class, which is a client used to interact with the AWS Marketplace Entitlement Service. It extends the generic AwsClient and includes methods for fetching entitlements synchronously and asynchronously.

classes.name: MarketplaceEntitlementServiceClient
classes.description: Client class to interact with AWS Marketplace Entitlement Service, extending AwsClient.

methods.name: getEntitlementsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches entitlements from AWS Marketplace.
